exclusions.name: Hospital administration or legal team
exclusions.why_safe: The committee charter states the decision is by majority vote of the three members; no other actors have a vote or veto.

exclusions.name: Patient or family input
exclusions.why_safe: The question is about the committee's approval decision, not about external advocacy; the committee's rules do not require patient/family input for the vote.

exclusions.name: Regulatory or legal constraints beyond the committee
exclusions.why_safe: The question is specifically about the committee's approval; any external constraints would affect implementation, not the committee's decision itself.

uncertainties.meaning: Whether Tomas Lindqvist prepared the safety review incorporating the updated data from 10 March before the meeting, given the timeline and his workload.
Whether the safety review was circulated to all members before the meeting, especially to Sister Doyle who is off-site and cannot receive email from 10-12 March.
Whether Dr. Osei votes to approve or reject, depending on whether she considers the safety review current and favorable.
Whether Dr. Patel votes to approve, which depends on whether a favorable safety review is available.
Whether Sister Doyle votes to approve, which depends on whether a documented safety assessment has been provided to her.
Whether the chair puts the motion to a vote, given her stated condition about current safety data.
